references.text: Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, a parallel account of the same situation
Israel put the Canaanites to forced labor instead of driving them out, the same pattern as in Joshua 16:10
King Solomon conquered Gezer, the city mentioned here where the Canaanites continued to live
Solomon made the remaining peoples into forced laborers, the same practice described with the term 'mas-oved'
God's warning that the Canaanites would become a snare if they were not driven out of the land
The command to completely drive out the Canaanites, which was not followed according to Joshua 16:10
A similar situation where the Israelites put the Canaanites to forced labor once they became strong enough
